Data attribution for Xinyi scenario study

Terrain: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Land Administration, Taiwan.
20 m DTM dataset 35430; source tiles used here were surveyed in 2006-2007 and
regridded in 2014. https://data.gov.tw/dataset/35430

District boundary: Taipei City Department of Civil Affairs, district boundary
20220915 edition. https://data.gov.tw/dataset/121199

Rain observations: Central Weather Administration, archived through the
Civil IoT Taiwan service operated by the National Center for High-performance
Computing. https://data.gov.tw/dataset/9177 ; https://history.colife.org.tw/

The above official dataset pages specify the Open Government Data License,
version 1.0: https://data.gov.tw/license . The original agencies are credited;
none endorses this research application or its scenario results.

Rain sewer geometry and historical flood references: Taipei City Hydraulic
Engineering Office. Exact dataset links and observed license wording are in
source_notices.json and DATA_SOURCES.md. The geometry used here is a derived
reference layer, not a verified hydraulic network.

No API keys, personal machine directories, licensed high-resolution maps,
school building plans, or private sewer plans are included in this data release.

Numerical grids and prepared scenarios are research derivatives. They do not
constitute calibrated flood forecasts, surveyed inlet depths, or probabilities.
Precomputed examples retain their Windows V2 computation date and provenance.

This notice is attribution, not a new license grant over third-party material.
